title: Chapter 232: Zhuyun Peak
content:
Chapter 232: Zhuyun Peak

Back then, Xiao Yin joined the Martial Arts Academy, and he was the strongest man in the younger generation of the Martial Arts Academy, leading the geniuses of the Martial Arts Academy to win one glory after another.

Now, Xiao Yin has returned to the academy again, but things have changed.

"Let's go in."

At the entrance of the canyon, a light golden light curtain slowly emerged, blocking the three of them.

Seeing this, Xiao Yin took out the token representing his identity.

The next moment.

Buzz —

The light curtain opened a gap, and the three of them entered directly without saying anything.

In just a moment, a strong fairy aura came to my face, refreshing.

This is the difference between the inner and outer courtyards.

There has never been any fairness. If you want to obtain better resources and environment, you only have talent and hard work.

Like Ye Teng, the energy of the Ye clan can send him into the outer courtyard of the academy.

But if you want to enter the inner courtyard, both conditions are indispensable.

Along the way, no one stopped Xiao Yin and the other two.

As the canyon gets deeper, the space in front of you is getting bigger and bigger.

I don’t know how long I walked, but my eyes suddenly became clear, with a fairy spirit floating in the air, and the attics lined up, and the sound of the great way kept echoing inside.

In the air, there are nine peaks hanging upside down, which is shocking.

This is the inner courtyard.

The real Tiandi Academy.

"Here I'm back."

Looking at the inner courtyard in front of him, Xiao Yin showed a meaningful smile.

Xiao Luo was breathing rapidly, his eyes emitting lightly at everything in front of him.

"Inner Courtyard, I, Xiao Luo, are finally here!"

On the side, Lu Xue didn't feel much.

I haven't seen any scene before.

At this moment, on the distant mountain peak, several scholars in white suddenly walked down the air and slowly came towards this place.

After a few breaths, the three of them saluted Xiao Yin and the other two respectfully.

"Dare you ask, but Teacher Xiao Yin?"

The person in charge said in a trembling voice, as the naked eye could see, his body was trembling slightly, and he was quite excited.

The same is true for the two behind them.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Yin did not hide his identity, "It's me."

Suddenly, the three of them took a deep breath, and the leader said respectfully, "Master Xiao Yin, we will take you to your residence."

There are nine peaks in the inner courtyard of the academy.

There is an inner courtyard tutor in every peak, which shows how high the inner courtyard tutor is in Tiandi Academy.

Xiao Yin naturally would not refuse this.

"I'm working hard."

"Teacher, this is what the young student should do."

The scholar in white wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and waved his hand quickly.

Who is the person in front of me? That is Xiao Yin, the number one monster in the martial arts academy million years ago, the top of the martial arts list, and even the top of the monsters list.

All academy geniuses look up to exist.

He could not have thought that he would have lived in his lifetime and saw the legend of living.

Yes.

To this day, Xiao Yin's feats that year are still spread throughout the academy.

When he learned that he was going to pick up Xiao Yinzhi, he almost died on the spot without being excited.

After all my virtue has been accumulated over the years, I finally have a reward.

The scholar in white sighed in his heart.

After a while, the three of them took Xiao Yin and the other two to an empty mountain.

This mountain is called Zhuyun Peak. Since the retirement of the previous tutor, it has been empty.

Now, Xiao Yin's arrival just fills the vacancy.

"Senior Xiao Yin, this is your residence. If you have any instructions, just give it a try, and I will definitely satisfy you."

Although the three of them are in the inner courtyard of Tiandi Academy, they are envied by countless people outside the world.

But the reality is that they are just doing odd jobs and sweeping the floor in the inner courtyard.

It is incomparable to those geniuses who have entered the inner courtyard with their own strength.

The only opportunity is to serve these tutors or students well to gain some opportunities.

Xiao Yin just nodded lightly in response to this.

"I understand, go down."

Xiao Yin waved his hand, and the three of them did not dare to say much, so they bent down and retreated quickly.

"Will the three of us live in such a big mountain in the future?"

At this time, Lu Xue looked around and asked immediately.

Hearing this, Xiao Yin nodded, "If nothing unexpected happens, it should be."

"Lu Xue, you two first stroll around this mountain and get familiar with the environment. When you have time later, I will take you to visit the inner courtyard."

"Sister Yin, do you want it?"

Xiao Yin looked outside and said helplessly: "I'm afraid the old guys in the inner courtyard have already known the news of my return, and I'm afraid they are on the way here."

"Next, I'm a little busy."

Hearing this, Lu Xue and the others understood.

"Sister Yin, let's go and have fun first. Ah no, let's go and have a look first."

Lu Xue said haha.

Then Lu Xue headed towards the mountain first.

When she was in place, Xiao Luo saw this, bowed and said, "Sister Yin, I'm going too."

Xiao Yin nodded, "Don't stay too far from Miss Lu, as there will inevitably be some danger in the inner courtyard."

These words made Xiao Luo's lips unable to help but rise.

Sister Yin actually trusts me so much, I will definitely not disappoint Sister Yin.

"Don't worry, Sister Yin, I will definitely protect Miss Lu."

Upon hearing this, Xiao Yin shook his head and said lightly: "I'm not asking you to protect her, but she protects you. Just remember to follow me."

Although Lu Xue does look a bit unreliable, Lu Xue is definitely not weak.

There are endless unknown treasures, and even I am not sure that I can take Lu Xue.

Do you still need to protect yourself, the immortal master?

When Xiao Yin said something, Xiao Luo's mouth twitched slightly.

I sat up in shock during the dying illness, and the clown was me.

Xiao Yin was right, and the old guys in the inner courtyard learned that Xiao Yin was back and became the mentor of the inner courtyard.

For a moment, the entire inner courtyard began to vibrate.

"Teacher, where are you going? The students have not finished practicing yet?"

"Practice yourself, I have something to do."

"By the way, I'm going to check when I come back. If you can't practice well, just wait and eat sticks!"

Such similar things began to happen from the inner courtyard.

The grade classification of the inner courtyard is also very clear.

Students, disciples, teachers, mentors, and then they are the president of the Academy of Literature and the president of the Academy of Martial Arts, and above all, the president of the General Academy.

As the instructor of the inner courtyard, Xiao Yin not only has an independent mountain as his residence.

You can also accept disciples.

Now, Lu Xue and Xiao Luo are Xiao Yin's disciples, and they can receive extremely rich resources every once in a while.

Just a moment later, under Zhuyun Peak, six old men with extraordinary auras and uniform dresses appeared here.

"What a coincidence. I thought, are you all moldy in the mountains?"

One of the red-browed old men was the first to mock everyone.

Hearing this, the rest of the people didn't say anything. Only one old man sighed, looked up at Zhuyunfeng, and slowly said, "If someone else entered the inner courtyard, I probably wouldn't have any reaction, but this girl is different."
